name: KINERGY
recent: Kinergy近期获得Gamuda子公司价值RM47.5百万的数据中心电气工程合约，并推进最多10%新股配售计划，已获Bursa Securities批准。同时，执行副主席兼集团董事经理Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn在闭市期外增持810万股。
notable: 获得Gamuda子公司价值RM47.5百万的超大规模数据中心电气工程合约。
497,717股新股（占已发行股份10%），已获Bursa Securities批准上市。
执行副主席兼集团董事经理Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn于2026年10月23日以约RM3.01百万增持810万股。
risks: 私下配售最多10%新股可能对现有股东造成股权摊薄。
董事在闭市期内表示有意交易公司证券。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为RM109.38百万，环比增长7.2%，同比增长11.9%；净利为RM9.06百万，环比增长22.8%，同比增长39.5%；净利率为8.3%，高于上一季度的7.2%。

recent_en: Kinergy recently secured a RM47.5 million data centre electrical works contract from a Gamuda unit and is progressing a private placement of up to 10% new shares, which has received Bursa Securities approval. Meanwhile, Executive Deputy Chairman cum Group Managing Director Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn acquired 8.1 million shares outside the closed period.
notable_en: Secured a RM47.5 million electrical works contract for a hyperscale data centre from a Gamuda unit.
Proposed private placement of up to 218,497,717 new shares (10% of issued shares), with listing approval from Bursa Securities.
Executive Deputy Chairman cum Group Managing Director Dato' Dr Lai Keng Onn acquired 8.1 million shares for about RM3.01 million on 23 October 2026.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
Directors have given notice of intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM109.38 million, up 7.2% QoQ and 11.9% YoY; net income was RM9.06 million, up 22.8% QoQ and 39.5% YoY; net margin was 8.3% versus 7.2% in the previous quarter.
